passages.text: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a shepherd.
He cared for the flock of Jethro.
Jethro was his father-in-law.
Jethro was the priest of Midian.
Moses led the flock through the wilderness.
He brought the flock to Horeb.
Horeb is the mountain of God.
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה הָיָ֥ה רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת־ צֹ֛אן יִתְר֥וֹ חֹתְנ֖וֹ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִדְיָ֑ן וַיִּנְהַ֤ג אֶת־ הַצֹּאן֙ אַחַ֣ר הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֛א אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽבָה׃

passages.text: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD appeared to Moses.
The angel appeared in a blazing fire.
The fire came from within a bush.
Moses saw the bush.
The bush was burning with fire.
The bush was not consumed by the fire.
passages.original: וַ֠יֵּרָא מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֵלָ֛יו בְּלַבַּת־ אֵ֖שׁ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֑ה וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַסְּנֶה֙ בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְהַסְּנֶ֖ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אֻכָּֽל׃

passages.text: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a shepherd.
He saw a bush on fire.
The bush was not burning up.
Moses said, “I will go over and see this great sight.”
He wondered, “Why is the bush not burning up?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אָסֻֽרָה־ נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה אֶת־ הַמַּרְאֶ֥ה הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה מַדּ֖וּעַ לֹא־ יִבְעַ֥ר הַסְּנֶֽה׃

passages.text: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called out to him from within the bush, “Moses, Moses!” “Here I am,” he answered.
passages.sermon:
The LORD saw Moses go over to look at the bush.
God spoke to Moses from inside the bush.
God called out, “Moses, Moses!”
Moses answered, “Here I am.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י סָ֣ר לִרְא֑וֹת וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֵלָ֨יו אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֗ה וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses from the burning bush.
God said, “Do not come any closer.”
God said, “Take off your sandals.”
God said, “The place where you are standing is holy ground.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־ תִּקְרַ֣ב הֲלֹ֑ם שַׁל־ נְעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עוֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔יו אַדְמַת־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses from the burning bush.
God said, “I am the God of your father.”
God said, “I am the God of Abraham.”
God said, “I am the God of Isaac.”
God said, “I am the God of Jacob.”
Moses heard God speak.
Moses became afraid.
Moses hid his face.
Moses was afraid to look at God.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֖ק וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיַּסְתֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנָ֔יו כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א מֵהַבִּ֖יט אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
The LORD is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The LORD said, “I have seen the suffering of My people in Egypt.
My people are the Israelites.
I have heard My people cry out.
Their oppressors in Egypt cause them pain.
I know about their suffering.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה רָאֹ֥ה רָאִ֛יתִי אֶת־ עֳנִ֥י עַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ צַעֲקָתָ֤ם שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י נֹֽגְשָׂ֔יו כִּ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ מַכְאֹבָֽיו׃

passages.text: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
The LORD has seen the suffering of His people in Egypt.
The LORD has come down to rescue His people from the power of the Egyptians.
The LORD will bring His people out of Egypt.
The LORD will bring them to a good land.
This land is spacious.
This land flows with milk and honey.
This land is the home of the Canaanites.
This land is the home of the Hittites.
This land is the home of the Amorites.
This land is the home of the Perizzites.
This land is the home of the Hivites.
This land is the home of the Jebusites.
passages.original: וָאֵרֵ֞ד לְהַצִּיל֣וֹ׀ מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֗יִם וּֽלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ֮ מִן־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִוא֒ אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ טוֹבָה֙ וּרְחָבָ֔ה אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֶל־ מְק֤וֹם הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

passages.text: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God sees everything.
God hears everything.
The Israelites are suffering in Egypt.
The Israelites cry out to God.
Their cry has reached God.
The Egyptians oppress the Israelites.
God has seen the oppression.
The Egyptians treat the Israelites very harshly.
God knows their pain.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֛ה צַעֲקַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣אָה אֵלָ֑י וְגַם־ רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הַלַּ֔חַץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹחֲצִ֥ים אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said, “Go now.
I am sending you to Pharaoh.
You will bring My people out of Egypt.
My people are the Israelites.
The Israelites are suffering in Egypt.
Pharaoh rules over Egypt.
You must lead the Israelites out from Pharaoh’s power.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔ה וְאֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֖ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְהוֹצֵ֛א אֶת־ עַמִּ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: But Moses asked God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to God.
Moses asked a question.
Moses said, “Who am I?”
Moses wondered why he should go to Pharaoh.
Moses questioned if he should bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ֣י אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אֵלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְכִ֥י אוֹצִ֛יא אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: “I will surely be with you,” God said, “and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, all of you will worship God on this mountain.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said, "I will be with you."
God promised His presence to Moses.
God gave Moses a sign.
God said, "This is the sign that I have sent you."
God said, "After you bring the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain."
God said, "You and the Israelites will serve Me here after leaving Egypt."
God made it clear that Moses would not be alone.
God assured Moses that the people would worship Him at this place.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כִּֽי־ אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֣ הָא֔וֹת כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י שְׁלַחְתִּ֑יךָ בְּהוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֤ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם תַּֽעַבְדוּן֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to God.
Moses said, “I may go to the Israelites.
I may say to them, ‘The God of your fathers sent me to you.’
They may ask me, ‘What is His name?’
What should I say to them?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֣י בָא֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י לָהֶ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְאָֽמְרוּ־ לִ֣י מַה־ שְּׁמ֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God revealed His name to Moses.
God said, “I AM WHO I AM.”
God told Moses what to say to the Israelites.
God said, “Tell the Israelites, ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽהְיֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses again.
God gave Moses a message for the Israelites.
God said, "Tell the Israelites this:
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
The LORD is the God of Abraham.
The LORD is the God of Isaac.
The LORD is the God of Jacob.
The LORD has sent me to you.
This is my name forever.
This is how every generation will remember me."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ע֨וֹד אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק וֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם זֶה־ שְּׁמִ֣י לְעֹלָ֔ם וְזֶ֥ה זִכְרִ֖י לְדֹ֥ר דֹּֽר׃

passages.text: Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—has appeared to me and said: I have surely attended to you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Moses, go and gather the elders of Israel.
Say to them, “The LORD has appeared to me.”
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
He is the God of Abraham.
He is the God of Isaac.
He is the God of Jacob.
The LORD said, “I have surely attended to you.”
The LORD has seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
passages.original: לֵ֣ךְ וְאָֽסַפְתָּ֞ אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵהֶם֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ נִרְאָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם יִצְחָ֥ק וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֤ד פָּקַ֙דְתִּי֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הֶעָשׂ֥וּי לָכֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God promised to help the Israelites.
God said, “I will bring you out of your suffering in Egypt.
I will take you to a new land.
This land belongs to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
This land has plenty of milk and honey.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֮ מֵעֳנִ֣י מִצְרַיִם֒ אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say, and you must go with them to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
passages.sermon:
The elders of Israel will listen to you.
You must go to the king of Egypt.
You must take the elders of Israel with you.
You must speak to the king of Egypt.
You must say, “The LORD is the God of the Hebrews.
The LORD has met with us.
Now let us travel three days into the wilderness.
We will offer sacrifices to the LORD our God.”
passages.original: וְשָׁמְע֖וּ לְקֹלֶ֑ךָ וּבָאתָ֡ אַתָּה֩ וְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֗יִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעִבְרִיִּים֙ נִקְרָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְעַתָּ֗ה נֵֽלֲכָה־ נָּ֞א דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְנִזְבְּחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God knows the king of Egypt.
The king of Egypt rules over the Israelites.
The king of Egypt will not let the Israelites go.
The king of Egypt will refuse to release them.
He will not let them go unless someone forces him with great power.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יִתֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם לַהֲלֹ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃

passages.text: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God is powerful.
God said, “I will stretch out My hand.
I will strike Egypt.
I will do many wonders among the Egyptians.
I will perform these wonders in their midst.
After I do this, the king of Egypt will let you go.”
passages.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֤י אֶת־ יָדִי֙ וְהִכֵּיתִ֣י אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹל֙ נִפְלְאֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses about the Israelites.
God said He would give the Israelites favor with the Egyptians.
The Egyptians would look kindly on the Israelites.
When the Israelites left Egypt, they would not leave empty-handed.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־ חֵ֥ן הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה בְּעֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֵֽלֵכ֔וּן לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ רֵיקָֽם׃

passages.text: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were slaves in Egypt.
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses what the Israelites must do.
Each Israelite woman will ask her Egyptian neighbor for silver jewelry.
Each Israelite woman will ask her Egyptian neighbor for gold jewelry.
Each Israelite woman will ask her Egyptian neighbor for clothing.
Each Israelite woman will also ask any woman staying in her house for these things.
The Israelites will take these gifts from the Egyptians.
The Israelites will put the jewelry and clothing on their sons.
The Israelites will put the jewelry and clothing on their daughters.
In this way, the Israelites will plunder the Egyptians.
passages.original: וְשָׁאֲלָ֨ה אִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ֙ וּמִגָּרַ֣ת בֵּיתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־ כֶ֛סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּשְׂמָלֹ֑ת וְשַׂמְתֶּ֗ם עַל־ בְּנֵיכֶם֙ וְעַל־ בְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
